title: Kicked Peppery Ukrainian Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and spicy Ukrainian dish featuring peppery sausage, crispy potatoes, and a kick of tabasco sauce, served in a stone bowl to cure any hangover.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian sausage
ingredients.notes: preferably homemade or from a Ukrainian deli

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large stone bowl or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to brown.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for about 10 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Add the chopped bell peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Slice the Ukrainian sausage and add it to the skillet, cooking for about 5 minutes, or until browned and crispy.
Add the tabasco sauce, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for about 5 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the kicked peppery Ukrainian sausage skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
